resale_co.name: Residential resale certificate (Certificate of Smoke Alarm and Carbon Monoxide Alarm Compliance, issued by the Building Department)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Wanaque Building & Zoning Department
resale_co.lead_time: Payment must reach the office before the inspection day; inspections are Monday 1pm to 3pm and Wednesday 7am to 9am
requirements: Smoke alarms listed to UL217 on each level, including the basement (not required in attics or crawl spaces), and within 10 feet of any sleeping area
Battery-only smoke alarms must have a 10-year sealed battery; units with changeable batteries are no longer allowed
Existing hardwired (110 volt) smoke alarms must be maintained; any over 10 years old must be replaced before the inspection
Carbon monoxide alarms listed to UL2034 within 10 feet of any bedroom (battery, plug-in or combination); hardwired CO alarms must stay hardwired
Homes with solar panels, a standby generator or battery storage need permanent weatherproof, UV-resistant labels (ANSI Z535.4) within 18 inches of the electrical panel and the meter pan

resale_co.how_to_apply: Call the Building Department at 973-839-3000 x 7120 to schedule, and pay the $200 fee in exact cash or by check made out to 'Wanaque Borough' before the inspection day. Inspections are Monday 1pm to 3pm or Wednesday 7am to 9am with no set appointment time; the certificate is issued at the inspection.

No separate building or housing inspection checklist for resale is posted, so the resale certificate appears to be this one smoke/CO certificate; the same $200 is listed under the fire certificate and is not a second fee. The Municipal Code chapter on certificates could not be opened (ecode360 is blocked). Main office: (973) 839-3000, building@wanaquenj.gov. Construction Official and Fire Subcode Official: Michael Hafner (x7128). Zoning Officer/Property Maintenance: Mack Azer (x7121); the page lists his email both as mazer@wanaqueborough.com and mazer@wanaquenj.gov. The certificate also covers change of tenancy in rentals.

The Borough's own Building & Zoning page and its March 2025 sheet confirm the Building Department issues the certificate, so the Building Department contact (from the Borough page) is recorded. The directory's (973) 839-6405 number and Kevin Platt's optonline address are not on any Borough page. The Borough's Fire Department page lists only the volunteer chiefs (Chief Mark A.
